_doc: One entry per prospect requirement. Fields: id, pri (MUST|SHOULD|COULD), req, capability (see engine/capabilities.json), dim (slot|strategy, for per-slot capabilities), how (talking point), optional rr/er/das (yes|partial|no; defaults come from the capability), title, note, options (for gap).

requirements.how: Recs Report campaign tab shows impressions per recommendation campaign (= slot). DAS: VARIATION_ENGAGEMENT / IMPRESSION per CAMPAIGN_NAME.
Recs Report strategy tab. DAS: STRATEGY_IMPRESSION rows with STRATEGY_NAME. Strategy impressions only count when the strategy returned results.
Recs Report clicks + CTR per campaign. Experience Report shows CTR per variation. DAS: ENGAGEMENT_TYPE = CLICK.
Recs Report strategy tab. DAS: CLICK rows carry STRATEGY_ID / STRATEGY_NAME and the clicked SKU.
Experience Report: Add to Cart as a secondary metric per variation (user-level, not tied to the clicked product). DAS: CLICK on SKU X followed by DPX 'Add to Cart' with productId X in the session.
DAS only: same click -> ATC join, grouped by STRATEGY_NAME of the click.
Recs Report: direct purchases/revenue per campaign. Experience Report: purchases per variation (user-level). DAS: units of the clicked SKU in the Purchase cart.
Recs Report: direct revenue per strategy. DAS: units / orders grouped by the clicked strategy.
UI gives CTR, revenue per 1,000 impressions and the user conversion rate per variation. DAS lets the customer use its own definition: attributed orders / impressions.
As A9, grouped by strategy.

requirements.req: Attributed revenue per slot (click -> PDP -> order)
requirements.how: Recs Report 'direct revenue' = purchase of a clicked recommended item within the attribution window (default 30 days, configurable). DAS: rebuild the exact click -> PDP view -> purchase path per SKU.
Recs Report strategy tab (direct revenue, revenue per 1,000 impressions). DAS: the same path grouped by strategy.

requirements.req: Add-on revenue per slot (PDP -> reco click -> PDP -> order) vs initial PDP
requirements.how: Not a standard UI metric (the Recs Report has direct and assisted revenue). DAS: the anchor product comes from CONTEXT_DATA of the PDP click; compare reco-item revenue with anchor-item revenue in the same order.
DAS only: as A13, grouped by strategy.

requirements.req: Product clicks per product ID, by slot
requirements.how: DAS only: SKUS on CLICK rows, grouped by CAMPAIGN_NAME. Note: DAS has no SKU-level impressions, so this is a click count, not a product CTR.

requirements.req: Product clicks per product ID, by strategy
requirements.how: DAS only: SKUS on CLICK rows, grouped by STRATEGY_NAME.

requirements.req: Time-over-time comparison per slot (WoW, YoY, range)
requirements.how: UI: free date-range picker, but no built-in WoW/YoY delta. DAS: any comparison. NB: DAS files are kept only 30 days in S3, so the customer must store them daily in BigQuery to get YoY.
As A17, grouped by strategy.
Recs Report monthly/weekly/daily trend. Experience Report data over time per variation. DAS: daily time series.
UI strategy tab for a selected date range. DAS: daily series per strategy.

requirements.req: Filters: site, device, locale, country, slot, category, strategy
requirements.how: UI: site via section, device and audience breakdowns in the Experience Report. DAS: every dimension. Country and locale come from SECTION_ID / URL; category comes from a join with the product feed.
Experience Report CSV export plus revenue event log. DAS: Parquet files, and every BI widget exports to CSV (try the download buttons).

DAS and the UI reports refresh daily. The Experience Report has a 'Today' near-real-time view. For true real time, also send reco click events to GA4 or a stream (the DY Experience API response holds slot and strategy IDs).
Experience Report audience breakdown (device, traffic source, new vs returning, custom audiences). DAS: AUDIENCES_NAMES, DEVICE, TRAFFIC_SOURCE.
The Recs Report shows revenue by page type. DAS + product feed join gives page (context) category and recommended-product category.
DAS delivers daily Parquet to S3 (s3://dy-raw-data-export[-eu]/sectionId=/date=/reportType=). Load with BigQuery Data Transfer Service (Amazon S3 source) or Storage Transfer.
DAS clicked SKU joined with the the product feed (color_group, material_group, price band). Measured as click share and click -> order rate; no CTR per attribute (no SKU-level impressions).
Best: A/B test the rule as a variation (with vs without), then read the Experience Report (probability to be best, uplift, credible intervals). DAS: the same variations at product level.

DAS: clicks, click share, ATC, units, revenue and click -> order rate per SKU x slot. GAP: DAS has no SKU-level impressions, so no product impressions or product CTR. Workaround: The customer logs the served SKUs from the DY API response / client callback to BigQuery.
As A29, per SKU x strategy. Same gap: no product impressions or product CTR in DAS.

requirements.req: Click-to-conversion funnel (click, ATC, order; main -> reco product sold)
requirements.how: DAS: impression -> click -> PDP view -> ATC -> order per slot, plus anchor -> recommended product pairs.

requirements.req: Recommendation coverage (% of products receiving recos)
requirements.how: DAS: viewed PDP SKUs with a STRATEGY_IMPRESSION (the strategy returned results) / all viewed PDP SKUs, per slot. Compare with the catalog from the feed. If the customer means '% of products that are shown AS a recommendation': DAS cannot measure this (no SKU-level impressions); clicked SKUs give only a lower bound.
Check the current DY scheduling and email options for the UI reports. On DAS: BI-native schedules and alerts (Looker / Power BI / Looker Studio), e.g. CTR drop > 20% WoW.
DAS only contains online DY events. Offline sales are not in DAS.
options: Send offline transactions to DY as a Purchase event with the customer's CUID, then they appear in DAS.
Join DAS to the customer's own POS data in BigQuery on a shared customer ID.
